metadata.time_allocation: Study hour (150h) = 22.5h contact hours + 22.5h online hours + 4.5h final project presentation + 1h final exam + 99.5h self-study
metadata.description:
This is a 3-credit course. This course has two parts: online and offline.
The content includes basic concepts and applications of IoT and practical exercises on learning KIT.
Students are taught how to learn online and practice some parts at home. Q&A sessions, Guidance for important issues, and performance assessments will be conducted in the classroom.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to learn all VIDEOs (theory) online given by instructor on Syllabus at home.
- Student is responsible to do all LABs given by instructor on Syllabus at home.
- Constantly follow https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information.

clos.lo_details: Understand the concept of IoT and applications.
Concept planning, Draw and Install simple IoT circuits
Understand the Arduino UNO and Atmega328 microcontroller architecture.
Know how to use the Simulation Software.
Understand the interrupts on Arduino UNO.
Understand the concept of things in IoT.
Select and calculate the electronics components, IoT Programming.
Program IN/OUT Digital with Arduino UNO.
Program Analog Input/Output with Arduino UNO.

assessment_scheme.grading_guide: The examination is conducted by the exam board. A minimum of two teachers is required for grading the Final Project. Each team is allocated 30 minutes for the presentation of their project followed by a Q&A session. Evaluation of the final presentation is based on the final report, project demonstration, and Q&A interaction. The grade is determined by averaging the grades given by the two teachers.
